title: Chris Bledsoe claims similar UFO sensitivity
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Chris Bledsoe claims similar UFO sensitivity, about 2000s-2020s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions Chris Bledsoe, a man in North Carolina, as one of a few people who claim a similar kind of sensitivity to UFOs. If true, it would mean some people have an unusual connection to these phenomena.
